evidence_quotes: Construção irregular em area de proteção a mananciais.
Demolição da parte irregular dos imóveis e recuperação ambiental.
rationale: The decision addresses irregular building expansion and suppression of native vegetation within a watershed protection zone (área de proteção a mananciais, referencing São Paulo State Law 13.579/09 on watershed protection), ordering demolition and environmental recovery. Under protocol rules, Brazilian mananciais protection cases are WATER for mananciais_calibrated_label and environmental_protection for governance_category_21, while strict_service_access_label is UNCERTAIN because the dispute involves land-use/demolition enforcement in a watershed protection zone without direct water utility service or abstraction/pollution adjudication.
